actual: After first runtime activation with HMM_EVOLUTION_RUNTIME_MODE=api_worker, every /api/v1/hmm-evolution endpoint fails HTTP 500. build_runtime() passes qe_read_client to CandidateArtifactResolver although its constructor accepts qe_asset_reader only. Existing unit tests mock the runtime and do not exercise real build_runtime wiring. Expected: runtime builds successfully, QE reads remain routed through QEExperimentAssetReader, and a regression test fails on constructor drift.
closure_requirements: Keep BUG JSON and GitHub Issue synchronized.
